# Local paid action dispatch fixture

Set `CONVEX_LOCAL_BINARY` to the cached local backend and run `python3 packages/tests/fixtures/compute-convex/dispatch/run.py` from a clean committed checkout with 3540/3541 free. The launcher verifies the selected Auth archive, uses a loopback-only sandbox and shared process supervisor, and stops when free disk falls below 2.5 GiB. This creates a new loopback deployment with telemetry disabled before sync, empty Boat configuration, no provider credentials, and stops its own backend. The fixture copies the product action source, changing only import paths and replacing `debitCompute` with a loopback-only synthetic counter. The registered product `renew` handler is re-exported unchanged. An internal claim adapter invokes the real `claimWindow` with paid mode enabled, and scheduled stop, notice, boundary and uncertainty handlers are inert. The initial fund wrapper calls the product `fund` helper with a synthetic adapter.

The test drives the registered renewal action after a funded active session's deadline is advanced to the present. It checks duplicate, premature and stale callbacks, a confirmed low remaining balance, denied and unknown debit results, and a confirmation released after the uncertainty handler. The synthetic stop handler is inert, and the notice handler records scheduling only. The low remaining balance and notice dispatch are checked; actual notice eligibility, delivery and the fresh-message resume UI are not proven here. The fixture does not contact Autumn or Boat, establish provider finality or hard-stop timing, or prove a complete renewal lifecycle. Never deploy the fixture or its public test endpoints.
